avis.titre: A Must Have For Dry, Dull and Dark Eyes!

The lid formula feels slightly richer and helps smooth that delicate, sometimes crepey texture without feeling heavy. The under eye side is lightweight but super hydrating, and it layers beautifully under makeup without pilling. My under eyes look brighter and more refreshed, and the whole area just feels softer and healthier overall. It's such a thoughtful, targeted eye product. Definitely a step up from a basic one-cream-for-all eye treatment.
